\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Non-collapsing volume bound for the blow-up sequence] There is $\eta >0$ such that eventually \[ \Vol (B_{Q_nG_n}(x_n,0,\eta ))\ge \kappa \eta ^3. \] \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch Rescaling preserves the stated $\kappa $-non-collapsing hypothesis, while the curvature bounds give the required fixed scale.
